• Are you having trouble with these symptoms?
  • What is hormone injection that is effective for aging care?
  • Hormone therapy for gender identity disorder (GID)
  • Expected effects of hormone injections
  • Side effects of hormone injections
  • Hormone injection cost

Are you having trouble with these symptoms?

  • My stomach is sagging, it's coming out.
  • Concerned about visceral fat
  • I started feeling tired quickly
  • I can't get tired even though I slept well
  • feel a decrease in muscle strength
  • I can't lose weight even if I exercise like I used to
  • I feel like my concentration and memory are decreasing
  • I get irritated over small things
  • feel a decrease in sexual desire
  • A decrease in bone density was noted.

What is effective hormone injection for aging care?

Growth hormone is a hormone that acts on organs throughout the body to promote their growth and repair damaged tissues.
It is a hormone secreted by the pituitary gland in the brain throughout life, but compared to the peak amount in the late teens, the amount decreases as we age, halving to about 50% in our 30s and 40s, and about 30% in our 60s.
By injecting this growth hormone into the upper arms, thighs, abdomen, buttocks, etc., you can expect to regain your youthful body, appearance, and mind.

Hormone therapy for gender identity disorder (GID)

At our hospital, we provide hormone injections to patients with GID (Gender Identity Disorder).
By performing hormone injections, you can expect to become a woman without orchiectomy or breast augmentation. Generally, treatments are performed once every 2 to 3 weeks. The effects begin to appear after about 1 to 4 months and become irreversible after about 6 months.
Hormone therapy may come with side effects, so we will explain them to you before treatment so that you understand them thoroughly.
Our hospital also performs orchidectomy (removal), so please feel free to contact us.

About orchiectomy

What is the best hormone injection for aging care?

Visceral fat reduction

By increasing lean body mass, body fat, including visceral fat, can be reduced.
Lean body mass is the total weight of muscles, bones, internal organs, etc. other than body fat.

Building strong bones

Administration of growth hormone promotes an increase in bone cortex and bone mass, and is expected to improve bone density.
For elderly people in particular, fractures caused by osteoporosis can significantly reduce QOL even after healing due to muscle weakness during periods of immobilization and rest. It may also lead to bedriddenness.

Increased muscle strength

As muscle reconstruction is promoted, you can expect to increase muscle mass and strengthen strength. By improving your motor skills through daily life and sports, you can live brighter and more happily every day. Increasing muscle mass also helps improve metabolism.

Skin improvement/aging care

Due to its antidiuretic effect and promotion of water reabsorption in the kidneys, it increases body fluid volume and is expected to improve skin quality.

Reduced risk of heart disease

It is expected to prevent abnormal lipid metabolism and the progression of arteriosclerosis by reducing LDL cholesterol (bad cholesterol), increasing HDL cholesterol (good cholesterol), and reducing triglycerides.

Prevention of dementia and diabetes

Research is already underway into its use as a preventive drug for dementia, and there are high hopes for its realization.
It is also expected to improve insulin resistance due to the reduction of visceral fat, thereby preventing diabetes.

Side effects of hormone injections

Side effects/risks

  • Rash, internal bleeding, swelling, and pain at the injection site
  • headache, nausea
  • bone and joint pain
  • Edema
  • carpal tunnel syndrome
  • slight increase in blood pressure
  • Decreased thyroid hormone production

Because it is a treatment that supplements the growth hormone that is naturally present in the body, it is said that side effects are rare. If you have any concerns, please feel free to contact us.

Clarification of information related to safety in other countries

In Japan, this product has not been approved under the Pharmaceutical and Medical Device Act.

About the acquisition route

All items are purchased from domestic distributors.
*Reference: Ministry of Health, Labor and Welfare's guidance regarding personal imports

https://www.yakubutsu.mhlw.go.jp/individualimport/healthhazard/

Other domestically approved drugs with the same ingredients and efficacy

There are no other domestically approved drugs that have the same ingredients and performance. *This will be a free medical treatment.

Those who cannot receive hormone injections

People who fall under the following conditions cannot receive hormone injections. Thank you for your understanding.

  • Those who are pregnant or breastfeeding
  • People with diabetes
  • People with liver disease such as hepatitis B or C
  • People with autoimmune diseases
  • People with collagen disease
  • People with endocrine diseases of the thyroid or pituitary gland
  • People undergoing cancer treatment
  • People with blood-related diseases such as leukemia, polycythemia, and multiple myeloma
